recall.minute: Machine learning builds programs from examples: a learner improves performance P on task T with experience E. Supervised learning uses labelled pairs to predict categories (classification) or numbers (regression); unsupervised learning finds clusters or compact representations; reinforcement learning learns a policy from rewards; semi-supervised mixes few labels with many unlabelled points. Learners can train in batch or online, and either store instances or fit models. Use ML when rules are hard to write, then follow the workflow: data, preprocessing, model and loss, optimisation, tuning and honest evaluation against a baseline.
